about: A guest added to the series at Google and not polled, then notes for all events taken by Google and stopped by a thrown error, then a colour set at Google, then Put back: refused with google_changed_since, since Google changed after the change's last step (x-putback, A2). The guest added before the failure is part of what the change started from and refuses nothing alone (a-guest-added-at-google-then-notes-for-all-stopped-after-their-write-then-put-back-goes-through). Its oracle probe answers Put back ok, which must be caught.
